description: This Java class 'SecurityUtil' provides security-related utility methods for permission checks, JWT token generation and validation, specifically for user login permissions within the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: SecurityUtil
classes.description: A utility class providing security functions such as permission checks, JWT token management, and permission validation within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: hasUserLoginAdminPermission
methods.description: Checks if a user login has at least one of the predefined admin permissions.

methods.name: hasUserLoginMorePermissionThan
methods.description: Determines if one user login has more permissions than another, returning the list of missing permissions.

methods.name: checkMultiLevelAdminPermissionValidity
methods.description: Checks if a permission is valid based on multi-level admin permission hierarchy.

methods.name: generateJwtToAuthenticateUserLogin
methods.description: Generates a JWT token for user login authentication, salted with user login ID and current password.

methods.name: authenticateUserLoginByJWT
methods.description: Validates a JWT token against a user login ID to verify authenticity.
